description.en:
The SAE application ID.

> You can call the [ListMachineApps](~~ListMachineApps~~) operation to obtain the ID.
The region ID of the application.

The cloud service to which the application belongs. Valid values:
- **ASK**
- **SAE**
- **ACS**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas get-serverless-app-auth-detail --vendor-type SAE --machine-type RunD --app-id 3de9f2ac-f000769226df --app-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas GetServerlessAppAuthDetail --region cn-hangzhou --AppId '3de9f2ac-f000769226df' --VendorType SAE --MachineType RunD --AppRegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
